standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: What is this place? This is Soul Wars, a glorious battleground where you must fight to crush the souls of your enemies!

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Really? Are souls easy to crush?
I see. So how does it all work?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: I can give you a demonstration if you're interested?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue.text: The player's run energy is restored to full.
The player is seen wearing the blue cape and blue icon.
The player turns to face the Avatar of Creation.
The player performs a panic emote.
The player runs towards Nomad automatically.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.npc: Welcome to Soul Wars! Let's get started.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.player: So, what's this place all about?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.npc: To the south you will have seen an avatar. You must fight to protect your team's avatar, and defeat the opposing team's avatar.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.player: Are you crazy? Have you seen the size of it?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.npc: You're here to fight, not whine.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.player: But how am I supposed to take on one of those?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.npc: By capturing the Soul Obelisk, which lies at the centre of the battleground, and offering it soul fragments.
Let's head towards the Obelisk now. I can point out some of the important landmarks on the way. Meet me to the north when you are ready to learn more.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.text: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports northwards.
Only the red team may enter this graveyard.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.npc: Hey! You don't need those. You're not in a real battle yet.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.text: You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-introdu.npc: Hey! Don't attack those. You're not in a real battle yet.
To continue the demonstration, come speak to me. I'm by the avatar in the south-west of the battleground.
This is one of the graveyards that your team can capture.
For the purposes of this demonstration, however, I have kept it inactive.
To continue the demonstration, come speak to me. I'm by the avatar in the south-west of the battleground.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-supplie.npc: You might find this little area behind me useful for defending your avatar. There's one in the other team's base, too.
During battle, you can gather supplies here to aid you and your teammates.
The Soul Obelisk is just a little way from here. Let's continue on; I'll meet you to the east.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-supplie.text: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports eastwards.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls.npc: Now, to have a chance against an avatar, you are going to need souls. Lots of souls.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls.player: What am I going to do with souls?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls.npc: The Soul Obelisk is immensely powerful and, by channelling souls into it, you can weaken the enemy avatar.
All I know is that it does, and that you should do it. Lots.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls.player: So, where do I get these souls from?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls.npc: You can kill the souls that inhabit the arena ruins and harvest their soul fragments.
For the purposes of this demonstration however, we will use my minion Zimberfizz.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-z.npc: When you kill a creature in Soul Wars, they will leave a soul fragment behind, which you can use to charge the Soul Obelisk.
Zimberfizz has such a soul fragment. Why don't you kill him and take it?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-z.player: You want me to kill him?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-t.npc: Come on! Kill him already and get that soul fragment.
Good job! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-t.text: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports eastwards.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-t.npc: Good job! Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
You've lost it? You're lucky you're not in a real battle yet!

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-t.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: soul fragment

steps.npc: Here, have this one. Just look after it this time.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-t.text: If the player's inventory is full:

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-t.npc: Now! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-souls-t.text: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports eastwards.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-the-sou.npc: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
You've lost it? You're lucky you're not in a real battle yet!

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-the-sou.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: soul fragment

steps.npc: Here, have this one. Just look after it this time.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-the-sou.text: If the player's inventory is full:

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-the-sou.npc: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, to reap the full benefit of the soul fragment, you will need to first be in control of the Obelisk.
Various areas of the battleground can come under your team's control. To gain control, you must have more team members than the opposing team in these areas.
If you outnumber the enemy, you will gradually take control. Let's try it out now.
We shall use Zimberfizz to represent an enemy team member.
Come on, give him a good kick.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-the-sou.player: I thought he was dead? Didn't we kill him earlier?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-the-sou.npc: Ha! He wishes! No, his service to me is far from over.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-area-co.text: The player automatically runs towards Nomad and starts talking to Nomad.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-area-co.npc: Ha! I'm sure he loves the attention, right Zimberfizz?
Right, now that Zimberfizz is no longer in the Obelisk's capturable area, you outnumber the enemy! The Soul Obelisk will now begin to fall under your control.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-area-co.text: Note the Obelisk's progress bar in the top-left of your screen. As you gain control over an area, this bar will fill with the colour of your team.
Once the bar is filled with your team's colour, you gain control of the area.
The neutral Obelisk is taken control by blue team.
You now have control over the Soul Obelisk; it has taken on your team's colour as a result. This is also shown by the Obelisk icon in the top-left of your screen.
The three icons at the top-left of the screen tell you which team has control of the capturable areas.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-area-co.npc: Right. Now, go and charge the Obelisk with that soul fragment and see what happens.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-chargin.npc: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
You've lost it? You're lucky you're not in a real battle yet!
Here, have this one. Just look after it this time.
Go on, use the soul fragment on the Obelisk.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-chargin.text: You charge the Soul Obelisk and weaken the enemy avatar.
Player starts running towards Nomad and talks to Nomad automatically.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.npc: Good job! Now that you have charged the Obelisk, the enemy avatar will have been weakened.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.text: Note the display in the top-left of the screen. See how the red avatar's strength has decreased.
The number shown here represents the percentage of your damage that the avatar will block.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.player: So, once I've charged the Obelisk, can I just kick back and wait for the end of the game?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.npc: Ha! I think not! I'm not about to reward those who don't put the effort in!

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.text: Note the orange bar in the top-left of the screen. This bar represents how active you have been during the game.
Over the course of the battle, the bar will slowly drain. Should the bar drain completely you will be removed from the game due to your inactivity.
You can refill the bar by performing actions in the game, such as dealing damage or charging the Obelisk.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.player: Oh well. Say, do you think the enemy avatar minds us weakening it like this?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.npc: Hmm, why don't we go find out?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.text: The screen fades to black. The player and Nomad are now by the red team's avatar area.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.npc: So, here we are in the enemy base.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.player: Is that the enemy avatar over there?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.npc: Yeah, and it looks like you made it pretty mad.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.player: What? You're the one that told me to weaken it!

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.npc: Ha! Don't worry - I won't let it kill you.
Of course, that doesn't mean I won't kill you.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-angry-a.text: Nomad casts a slow projectile Iban's Blast spell without an Iban's staff at the player, with the sound of a trident of the swamp spell cast, instantly killing the player, taking the player back to the blue team's base in the form of a ghost.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-ghost.text: If the player doesn't do anything for 15 seconds:

steps.text: The player returns to life.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-death-t.text: When you die in Soul Wars, you become a ghost.
After 15 seconds as a ghost, you return to life and can carry on with the fight.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-death-t.npc: At least it wasn't permanent! Think of it as an opportunity to learn.
The other team will be after you and any soul fragments you have collected, after all.
I needed to show you what happens when you fall in battle.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-death-t.player: Did you turn me into a ghost?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-death-t.npc: Not exactly. The Soul Obelisk tried to claim your soul, as it does with all who perish in the battleground.
Only my power brought you here, and returned you to life.
You're more useful to me alive... for now.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-death-t.player: Are there any other painful things to learn about this place?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-death-t.npc: There is much more to this place, but you don't need to know about it yet.
If you want to learn more, I can give you a Soul Wars guide upon our return to the waiting area.
Use the large blue portal at the back of this graveyard to return to the waiting area. Why not sign up for a battle while you're there?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-leaving.npc: Use the portal over there to return to the waiting area. I'll see you on the other side!

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-leaving.text: The player's camera fades to black and the player leaves the tutorial and returns to Soul Wars lobby. The player loses the blue cape and blue icon.
